title: AI bubble burst by...?
description: This market will resolve to "Yes" if at least three of the following events occur within any 90-day window ending on or before December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET: (1) NVDA closes 50% or more below its all-time high closing price; (2) SOXX closes 40% or more below its all-time high closing price; (3) TSMC, ASML, Broadcom, Arista or Supermicro closes 50% or more below its all-time high closing price; (4) the Silicon Data H100 rental index (SDH100RT) is at or below $1.00/hour for 5 consecutive days; (5) OpenAI or Anthropic files for bankruptcy; (6) OpenAI is acquired. [FIXTURE SINTÉTICO: texto de prueba, no es el reglamento original]
